newsitem.title: UK: US stocks stagnant in London, awaiting jobs data.
newsitem.headline: US stocks stagnant in London, awaiting jobs data.

text.p: U.S. stocks were stagnant in light trading in London on Friday as European investors awaited a slew of key economic data due for release today.
Markets in Switzerland were closed for a holiday, thinning activity out further, dealers said.
"There's absolutely nothing happening. Shares are trading near their New York (closing) levels. Everyone is waiting on these figures," said one dealer.
On Globex, September S&P 500 futures were down 0.65 point to 957.30 at 1016 GMT, while September long bond futures were up 1/32.
Dealers said the opening on Wall Street will depend upon the data.
At 1230 GMT, July employment data will be published. Non-farm payrolls, a key indicator of the state of the economy, is expected to have increased by 193,000.
The unemployment rate is expected to have slipped to 4.9 percent in July from 5.0 percent in June.
Average hourly earnings, personal income and spending, factory orders, the National Purchasing Managers Index and consumer confidence data also are due for release today.
